data.long_meaning: The name Ihtesham is derived from the Arabic root h-t-sh-m, which means 'to love' or 'to be fond of'. It is a name that conveys a deep sense of admiration, respect, and love. In Islamic tradition, the name is often given to children who are cherished and held in high regard by their families and communities. The name Ihtesham carries the meaning “Admiration, love, respect” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ihtesham usually hope their child will grow to embody admiration, love, respect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
